reviewerOrPass: Worker B, same AI, separate source-first pass
independenceMethod: The same AI separately reopened the exact annual study product, seminar and project records, reconstructed all three years and considered the regulation and catalogue differences. It then rechecked programme claims against the selected course evidence and the frozen schedules and audience content.
findings: The annual catalogue and current annex establish 60+60+60 EC. The programme chart’s earlier first-year credit split is superseded by exact modules and the annex. Research Design occupies one 5 EC slot. The annex retains an older course code; the current Research Design module confirms the research progression. The selected seminar has a portfolio and tests and requires all 60 EC of the first year. The Bachelor Project requires 40 second-year EC and the three specified methods courses in addition to the first year. It combines thematic work with an individual 7,000–8,000 word thesis that must separately pass. The elective space requires approval. UCR has meaningful international relations, comparative politics, EU studies, law, economics and empirical methods. The broad option adds governance of sustainability, while the security option adds a disciplinary history paper, criminal law, warfare, youth resilience and predictive methods. These retain distinctive aims without treating the history paper as a political science thesis. The labels, course-description selections, elective and thesis notes, and all component references match the finished records.
